answer.text: Is influenced by client cash flows
Neutralises effects of external cash flows (deposits/withdrawals)

explanation.text: The Logic: TWRR neutralises the effects of external cash flows; deposits and withdrawals do not affect TWRR, making it suitable for evaluating the investment approach itself. The Trap: Cash-flow-sensitive measures such as IRR/XIRR are influenced by deposits and withdrawals, so they are used for investor-level reporting, while TWRR is used for the investment approach. Note: The XXI-A workbook contrasts TWRR (investment approach performance) with XIRR (investor reporting).
